stories.title: Israël et le Maroc s'accordent pour ouvrir des ambassades dans leurs pays

en.title: Israel and Morocco agree to open embassies in their respective countries
en.summary: Israel and Morocco will establish embassies in each other's countries, announced by Israel's foreign ministry. The agreement follows a meeting between the two countries' top diplomats in New York, facilitated by the United States.

stories.title: Un cratère récent découvert sur la Lune grâce aux images d'une sonde

en.title: Recent crater discovered on the Moon thanks to probe images
en.summary: An American researcher identified a large crater recently formed on the Moon's surface using NASA probe imagery. According to scientists, such an event occurs approximately once per century.

stories.title: Für die Nations-League-Spiele – Yakin bietet Boteli und Britschgi auf – auch Manzambi dabei

en.title: For the Nations League matches – Yakin names Boteli and Britschgi – Manzambi included
en.summary: National team coach Murat Yakin announced his squad for the first four Nations League matches on Thursday.

stories.title: Mädchenschule bombardiert – UNO-Bericht sieht mögliche US-Kriegsverbrechen im Iran

en.title: Girls' school bombed – UN report sees possible US war crimes in Iran
en.summary: A UN commission investigation found that two US air strikes in Iran could potentially be classified as war crimes.

stories.title: Mit Boteli und Britschgi in den Herbst: Yakin bietet zwei Debütanten für die Fussball-Nationalmannschaft auf

en.title: With Boteli and Britschgi into autumn: Yakin nominates two debutants for the football national team
en.summary: Coach Murat Yakin announced his squad for the national team's Nations League matches scheduled for September and October, including two players making their debut.

stories.title: Le Conseil d'Etat genevois table sur un déficit de plus de 540 millions en 2027, un plan d'économie prévu

en.title: Geneva State Council projects deficit of over 540 million in 2027, savings plan planned
en.summary: Geneva's state government forecasts a budget deficit of 546.2 million francs for 2027 and has prepared a savings plan worth 247.7 million francs, with a significant portion tied to expert recommendations.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Iran-Krieg: UNO-Bericht sieht mögliche Kriegsverbrechen durch die USA in Iran

en.title: LIVE TICKER - Iran war: UN report sees possible war crimes by the USA in Iran
en.summary: The United States and Iran have been in a state of war since February 2026. After agreeing to a ceasefire, President Trump declared it ended in early July, with a UN report now examining potential war crimes.

stories.title: Les 20 millions pour la table ronde pour les victimes de Crans-Montana validés par le National

en.title: 20 million for round table for Crans-Montana victims validated by the National Council
en.summary: The National Council approved 20 million francs designated for a round table addressing victims of the Crans-Montana incident.

stories.title: Le Conseil national accepte de débloquer 20 millions pour la table ronde de Crans-Montana après un débat sur la solidarité fédérale

en.title: National Council approves 20 million francs for Crans-Montana round table after debate on federal solidarity
en.summary: Switzerland's National Council approved 20 million francs in federal funding to address consequences of the Crans-Montana fire through a coordination roundtable. The measure passed with 106 votes against 87 after earlier approval by the Council of States.

stories.title: Genève prévoit un déficit de 550 millions de francs pour 2027, malgré près de 250 millions d’économies supplémentaires

en.title: Geneva plans deficit of 550 million francs for 2027, despite nearly 250 million in additional savings
en.summary: Geneva's cantonal government announced its 2027 budget proposal projecting a deficit of 546 million francs. The budget includes nearly 250 million francs in cost-saving measures derived from the Zuin report.

stories.title: Près d'un milliard de francs de dommages annoncés pour la grêle qui a frappé fin août

en.title: Nearly one billion francs in damages announced for hailstorm that struck in late August
en.summary: A hailstorm that hit Switzerland in late August caused approximately one billion francs in insured damages, according to the Swiss Insurance Association. This figure accounts only for claims to cantonal property insurers.

stories.title: Aide aux victimes de Crans-Montana: les 20 millions qui divisent encore à Berne

en.title: Aid to Crans-Montana victims: the 20 million francs still dividing Bern
en.summary: Swiss victims of a New Year's fire in Crans-Montana have received promised payments of 50,000 francs each. Parliament's lower chamber must vote Thursday on an additional 20 million francs for a roundtable initiative, which the Swiss People's Party opposes.

stories.title: KURZMELDUNGEN - Wirtschaft: Helvetia Baloise legt erstmals nach Fusion Halbjahresergebnis vor

en.title: BRIEF REPORTS - Business: Helvetia Baloise presents first half-year results following merger
en.summary: Helvetia Baloise has released its first half-year financial results following the completion of its merger.

stories.title: «Die Schweiz muss keinem Bündnis beitreten. Eine pragmatische Zusammenarbeit ist aber sinnvoll», sagt der britische Botschafter in der Schweiz

en.title: "Switzerland does not need to join any alliance. But pragmatic cooperation makes sense," says the British ambassador in Switzerland
en.summary: The British ambassador to Switzerland discusses his country's and Switzerland's unique positions in the current security situation, noting that neither nation is an EU member despite their historical connections to Europe.

stories.title: Immobilienkonzerne enteignen? Berlin streitet über Lösungen für die Wohnungsnot

en.title: Expropriate real estate corporations? Berlin disputes solutions for housing shortage
en.summary: Five years after Berliners voted to socialize 240,000 apartments, virtually no action has been taken. The debate has resurged during the election campaign and could create serious problems for Germany.

stories.title: Erster Showdown in der UBS-Kapitalfrage: Warum AT1-Anleihen den Kompromissvorschlag des Ständerats torpedieren könnten

en.title: First showdown in the UBS capital question: Why AT1 bonds could torpedo the upper house's compromise proposal
en.summary: The Swiss upper house is discussing a compromise for UBS involving crisis bonds. However, these instruments raise more questions than they solve and could prolong uncertainty for the major bank.

stories.title: Der oberste Banker der Schweiz will wieder schweigen

en.title: Switzerland's top banker wants to stay silent again
en.summary: Marcel Rohner is stepping down as president of the Swiss Bankers Association after five turbulent years leading the organization.
